# Berlin to Lisbon Trip Options: Best Value for Two Adults

For your priorities — **lowest total cost first**, then **travel time**, then **baggage convenience** — **Option A is the best overall choice**. It is nonstop like Option C, has checked bag included, and is much cheaper than C while avoiding the time penalty of Option B.

# Ranked Comparison for 2026-04-10 to 2026-04-15

| Option | Flight Type | Baggage | Per Person | Total for 2 | Travel Time | Best For |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| A | Nonstop | 20 kg checked bag | €420 | **€840** | Fastest tier | Best balance of price + convenience |
| B | 1 stop | Carry-on only | €310 | **€620** | Slower due to stop | Lowest upfront cost |
| C | Nonstop | Checked bag + seat selection | €505 | **€1,010** | Fastest tier | Most extras, but highest price |

## Best Choice: Option A

- **Why it wins:** It gives you the **best mix of price and speed**.
- **Cost difference:**
  - Versus B: **€220 more total** for nonstop travel and checked baggage
  - Versus C: **€170 less per person** while still nonstop and bag-included
- **Convenience:** Checked bag included means less hassle than carry-on-only travel.
- **Travel time:** Nonstop is a major advantage over a one-stop itinerary.

## How the Options Stack Up

- **Option A**: Best overall value if you want a comfortable trip without overpaying.
- **Option B**: Best only if your absolute priority is spending the least money and you can travel light.
- **Option C**: Best if seat selection is very important to you, but it is hard to justify the extra cost given your priorities.
